node.title: The prize-admissible F2 object: the 16-rung KoalaBear tower is NOT admissible (cap broken from rung 4); on the admissible region (v_2(e) <= 2, e <= 6, log2 p >= 39, depth <= 2) the descent collapses to LEMMA ADM-2's exact direct sum of prime-field GRS codes (dim L EXACT), the generating classes are exactly three (Lucas-certified non-empty; e in {3,5,6} can never generate), and the coset domain costs the first moment a factor of exactly 1 (THEOREM C1)
node.statement: Admissible region at n = 2^41: v_2(e) <= 2, e <= 6, log2 p >= 39, tower depth <= 2 (f2_tq_pin CATCH-1: the 16-rung tower breaks |F| < 2^256 from rung 4). LEMMA ADM-1/2/3: for D = 41 - v_2(p-1) <= 2, L^perp decomposes as a direct sum of C prime-field GRS/MDS class kernels [S, S-R, R+1]_p, dim_Fp L = C min(S,R) EXACTLY, Z(L) = Z_1^C; the ADM-3 upper-bound constant is k = ord_n(p), not [F_q:F_p] (corrects f2_sl1b LEMMA SL-1b-DIM off-tower). Depth-budget: t <= n/(2^D(41-D)). THEOREM G1/G2: generating classes are exactly (e_p,e,k) in {(>=41,1,1),(40,2,2),(39,4,4)}, all non-empty with Lucas p-1 certificates; e in {3,5,6} can never generate since ord mod 2^41 is a 2-power. THEOREM C1: the rules-level coset domain g mu_n costs E_{K1}[T_W] a factor of EXACTLY 1 (bijection phi_g; verified by a disjoint group-ring route). THEOREM A discharges only order layers <= 42 - log2 L (0.78% of the domain at prize-max; no moving rung, minimum shortfall 39x); (M3) vacuous on admissible rows. NOT claimed: any Z_1 bound; (O1)'s status; the antipodal law on cosets (open — the coset gap is confined to the parity/descent machinery by C1).
